concept.logline: On overcast, mysterious Calwynhallow, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the glyph tablets and restore the Temple of Vines.

actions.value: On overcast, mysterious Calwynhallow, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the glyph tablets and restore the Temple of Vines.
Light the beacons in order: Flooded Stair → Strangler Fig Court, then the Temple of Vines.
Next in the circuit: the Flooded Stair.
The Flooded Stair flares; its beam points toward the Strangler Fig Court.
Next in the circuit: the Strangler Fig Court.
The circuit is closed. The Temple of Vines answers.
The circuit runs Flooded Stair → Strangler Fig Court.
Every beacon burns. Temple Lights at Dusk is lit again.
You are badly hurt. Back off and recover.

nodes.speaker: Professor Ember
nodes.text: So you've come to Jungle Dig Camp at last. I am Professor Ember. On overcast, mysterious Calwynhallow, you unravel the mechanisms to recover the glyph tablets and restore the Temple of Vines.

choices.text: What do you need from me?

nodes.speaker: Professor Ember
nodes.text: Back again. Jungle Dig Camp is quieter while you're out there.

nodes.speaker: Professor Ember
nodes.text: Go to Flooded Stair, then Catacombs. Whatever still remembers Temple Lights at Dusk is out there. Bring it back to me.

nodes.speaker: Professor Ember
nodes.text: They say Jungle Dig Camp was built on what was left of an older place. Wondrous, even then. Ask the stones and they won't argue.

nodes.speaker: Professor Ember
nodes.text: Flooded Stair: Flooded Stair: a dock on the way out from Jungle Dig Camp.

nodes.speaker: Professor Ember
nodes.text: You found something out there. I can see it on you. That's one piece of Temple Lights at Dusk back where it belongs.

nodes.speaker: Professor Ember
nodes.text: Catacombs: Catacombs: a cave on the way out from Jungle Dig Camp.

nodes.speaker: Maren the Scholar
nodes.text: Maren the Scholar circles your feet, then looks toward Temple of Vines as if it already knows the way.

nodes.speaker: Maren the Scholar
nodes.text: Maren the Scholar hums quietly, the way it does before the weather turns.

nodes.speaker: Maren the Scholar
nodes.text: It turns toward Temple of Vines. Temple of Vines: the far end of the grand loop, where the story ends.

nodes.speaker: Lyra the Trader
nodes.text: Welcome to my corner of Jungle Dig Camp. Lyra the Trader's wares have come a long way to get here.

nodes.speaker: Lyra the Trader
nodes.text: Rope, oil, dried fruit, and maps of Temple Lights at Dusk that are only a little wrong. Nothing you can't find for yourself, if you're patient.

nodes.speaker: Lyra the Trader
nodes.text: People say lights move at Flooded Stair after dark. I don't go there myself.

nodes.speaker: Ruin Moth
nodes.text: The ruin moth freezes, watches you with one bright eye, and looks ready to bolt.
